messages.content: Help me generate the XContent with xContentBuilderInstance for a RootObjectMapper that includes default settings for dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, and numeric detection, while skipping runtime fields?

function.name: RootObjectMapper_doXContent
function.description: Serializes the RootObjectMapper settings to XContent, with options to include default values and to skip runtime fields. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

builder.description: The XContentBuilder to which the content should be written. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

params.description: Parameters controlling the serialization, including whether to include defaults and whether to skip runtime fields. This is Java ArrayList type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type any; they are not in string representation.

We need to call the function RootObjectMapper_doXContent with builder and params. We need to provide builder as string representation of XContentBuilder instance. And params as string representation of Java ArrayList containing parameters controlling serialization: include defaults and skip runtime fields. We need to include default settings for dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, numeric detection. But the function likely serializes the mapper's settings. We need to pass appropriate params: maybe includeDefaults=true, skipRuntimeFields=true. So we need to construct an ArrayList with two booleans? The function signature expects params: string representation of Java ArrayList type. So we need to produce something like "[true, true]"? But the order matters: first includeDefaults, second skipRuntimeFields. So we can pass "[true, true]". builder: string representation of XContentBuilder instance. We can just say "xContentBuilderInstance". So call:

functions.RootObjectMapper_doXContent({ builder: "xContentBuilderInstance", params: "[true, true]" })

But we also need to mention dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, numeric detection. Those are part of the mapper's settings. The function will serialize them if includeDefaults is true. So we just need to pass includeDefaults=true. So final answer: call the function with builder and params.
